atAGlance: Lẩu bò is beef hot pot, usually with thin beef, greens, tofu, noodles, and shared broth.
whatItIs: Lẩu bò is beef hot pot with broth, sliced beef, meatballs or tendon, tofu, greens, mushrooms, herbs, and noodles. It is a table meal, not a quick bowl.
howToEnjoy: Cook beef briefly so it stays tender, then add greens and noodles later. Ask for less spicy broth before the pot arrives.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu bò by table size and ask what cuts are included. Request extra greens, extra noodles, or less spicy broth before cooking starts.
worthKnowing: Vietnamese beef hot pot is social food, often stretched over conversation with rounds of greens and noodles.
goodToKnow: Cook thin beef briefly so it stays tender, then add greens and noodles in later rounds. The pot is meant to stretch over conversation.
